source.organization: Australian Taxation Office (ATO) — Australian Business Register
source.attribution: Australian Business Register / Australian Taxation Office (CC-BY 3.0 AU)

parsing.notes: TWO zips (public_split_1_10.zip, public_split_11_20.zip), each 20 XML files (Public01..20). STREAM <ABR> elements (SAX/iterparse). Dates YYYYMMDD. Validate against bulkextract.xsd. Resource UUIDs may change per weekly publish — resolve from the data.gov.au dataset. Filter ASICNumber present (or EntityType) for companies. Redact IndividualName.

mapping_rules.company_id: Use ABN; for companies also keep ASICNumber (ACN).
mapping_rules.registration_number: Use ASICNumber (ACN) for companies; else ABN.
mapping_rules.vat_id: Not available — record GST registration (no separate VAT number).
mapping_rules.status: Map ABN @status: ACT->active, CAN->cancelled (note: ABN status, not ASIC status).
mapping_rules.is_company: True when ASICNumber present / EntityType in {PUB, PRV, ...}.

fixture_requirements: public company (PUB) with ACN + GST (e.g. ABN 11000000948)

live_test_plan.smoke: Open public_split_1_10.zip, stream the first 1000 <ABR> records, assert ABN + EntityType.
live_test_plan.full: Weekly: stream both zips to NDJSON keyed on ABN; redact IndividualName; filter companies by ASICNumber.

blockers: Individual/sole-trader names are personal data (Privacy Act) — redact.
No street address / incorporation date / ANZSIC / financials — need paid ASIC.
